a: 2 years; €36,000/yr gross, plus travel to and from Bari
e: Two-year postdoc on astrophysical probes of weakly interacting slim particles (axions, dark photons, massive gravitons) in stars, supernovae and neutron stars, including multi-messenger signatures with gamma rays, neutrinos and gravitational waves. Open to non-Italian citizens with a PhD from a foreign institution, and to Italian citizens who have held a position abroad for at least three years.
n: INFN Bari: Postdoctoral Fellowship in Theoretical Astroparticle Physics (WISPs)
